name: Cambridge Farmers' Market
tagline: City Center Market, 122 Buchanan Street N, Cambridge, MN (2026)
description: Cambridge Farmers' Market gathers local farms and food producers in 122 Buchanan St N, MN. The market is a hub for seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from nearby growers. Hours and availability change with the season, so confirm before visiting.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
